CustomField.description: Salted hash of the code the person keeps. A web visitor is anonymous, so there is no address to reply to. Rather than promise a reply we cannot deliver, we hand them a code and they come back with it, on any channel, to the same handler without explaining again.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Never shown to staff. The person's own copy is the only readable one.
CustomField.label: Return Code Hash
